items.question: How many students did the initial phase of The Digital School, the UAE online education initiative, start with in November 2020?
items.fact: Initial phase started November 2020 with 20,000 students.

items.question: By what year does The Digital School, the UAE online education initiative run by Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives, aim to reach one million students?
items.fact: Aims to reach one million students by 2026.
